_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. The slides area: item bars, tiles, tags (set in capitals), arrangements, empty states. A song's group is частина, an arrangement порядок виконання (порядок for short, and in a new arrangement's saved name). The words on a media tile (slides.media.*, slides.playlist.playing) are set in capitals across the tile and take their .short form when the tile is too narrow.
